notes: Rebuilds the old 2023 page (in the rewrite queue) in place, so the URL keeps its history. It's the hub for the topical-oils cluster: 'rosemary oil for hair growth' and its variants are about 60,500 searches a month (KD 33). The page currently ranks around position 70-90.
Removes the old wording 'This can slow or even prevent hair loss', the 2023 product widgets, the testimonial and the dead link to /peppermint-oil-hair-growth.

FAQ built from Google's 'People also ask' for 'rosemary oil for hair growth' and 'rosemary hair oil for growth': faster growth, how to apply, homemade oil, thinning hair, skin. Plus rosemary vs minoxidil.

3 studies, each linked once in the references: the 6-month randomized trial vs minoxidil 2%, the mouse/lab study on 5α-reductase, and a 2025 review of non-prescription options that covers rosemary, caffeine, pumpkin seed oil and saw palmetto (all in the Hair Revival line).

Spokes: peppermint, pumpkin seed, castor, batana, lavender, essential oils, caffeine, scalp massage. Links across to the planned 'how to stop hair loss' and vitamins hubs. Product links are blog-to-product only (Hair Revival Serum, Supplements, Kit 30-Day).
Product wording is structure/function: 'designed to support a healthy scalp and fuller-looking hair'. Serum ingredients are from the product sheet.
flags: Links to /how-to-stop-hair-loss (new) and /best-hair-growth-vitamins (being rebuilt), so publish the hair-growth hubs together.
The lavender spoke says aromatherapy 'could effectively treat alopecia areata' (a 1998 study). That's a disease-treatment claim on an older page; worth softening in a later pass.
